meta_description:
23K likes, 272 comments - onlywhatsneeded on October 20, 2026: "This is my first ever time being on a billboard!

At Only What’s Needed, we don’t spend on paid promotions, so I’m extremely grateful to @selvel1945 for helping us put up this billboard for free, once again.

But this billboard comes at a particularly special time because, after 6 long months of being out of stock and having to destroy 15,000 packs that failed our pesticide test, our Plant Protein is FINALLY BACK! This time, in Cocoa.

But we didn’t want to simply bring it back. We wanted to make it better. This one tastes way better than our earlier plant protein. 

Earlier, we tested only our finished product. Now, we’ve added 20+ tests on our raw materials alongside our existing finished-product testing to make our quality checks even more rigorous.

Plant Protein Cocoa is now available on the Only What’s Needed app and website.

Let’s make India protein-sufficient, together! 🇮🇳".
